description: The line plot illustrates the performance of different methods in relation extraction as a function of the number of samples generated. The x-axis represents the number of samples generated, with values at 16, 32, and 64. The y-axis measures the Micro F1 score, ranging from 25% to 50%. The TACRED method, represented by a blue line with diamond markers, shows a steady increase in performance as the number of samples increases. The TACRED-Revisit method, indicated by an orange line with square markers, also shows an upward trend but with a more pronounced increase between 32 and 64 samples. The Re-TACRED method, depicted by a green line with triangle markers, starts with a lower performance at 16 samples but surpasses the other methods at 32 samples and maintains a higher performance at 64 samples. The SemEval method, shown by a red line with star markers, begins with the highest performance at 16 samples but experiences a slight decline as the number of samples increases.
